2026-06-08 — Post-v1.1.0 maintenance + v1.1.1 SHIPPED. All prior-handoff items cleared; backlog groomed.

v1.1.1 SHIPPED (parity-completeness patch): #121 unified `rvr init`'s CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md onto a shared core (REVERIE_CORE_GUIDE) that names both surfaces — prefer MCP, fall back to CLI with identical functionality; the MCP handshake blob (DEFAULT_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS) now states CLI parity too. Released via tag v1.1.1: workflow fully green, GitHub Release + 4 binaries live, tap formula auto-bumped to 1.1.1. #121 closed.

KEY WIN: HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN rotation is PROVEN — the v1.1.1 "Update Homebrew Tap" job succeeded (v1.1.0's had failed on the expired PAT). Releases self-serve again.

ISSUE GROOMING: filed #122 (project.* never-shed) and #123 (deploy-key for the tap token), then CLOSED both not-planned — #122 is tracked by #84 (the archived-lifecycle spec retires the project.* carve-out), and #123's PAT rotation is sufficient (annual manual rotation acceptable; reopen if it stings). #84 now owns the archived-lifecycle design (chosen over an _archive/ folder; git + docs/ are the history layer).

ALSO DONE: store hygiene — pruned/compressed historical project.* (~35KB→~21KB), rewrote project.inFlight current+lean.

NEXT (no urgent items): #119 WS3 session-state parity; #120 envelope-from-handler-return refactor; #84 entry-health design (carries the archived-state spec); v1.15 search theme (#13/#43, user-flagged).
